zoe: Quick idea  small after-work sandwich & trivia in the kitchen today? 5:45pm start, casual. who wants to swing by? :sandwich: :brain:

omar: Im in. I can grab rolls + some hummus. Gluten-free ok?

nina: Love that. need GF. I can bring a GF loaf and a little fruit platter.

dylan: Ill host a 10-min trivia round (music round?) and bring a tiny prize.

zoe: @dylan yes music round sounds fun. @omar thanks re hummus. @nina amazing. anyone want to add to a shared tab for drinks?

lunchbot: Poll: "Start time" 5:45pm / 6:00pm. Vote with :one: or :two:. (poll id 9344)

omar: voted :one: (5:45)

nina: voted :one: (5:45)
dylan: voted :two: (6:00) but fine with 5:45 if most vote that.

zoe: Plan: show up 5:40 to set up, quick mingle, trivia at ~6:00. I'll grab napkins/plates.

omar: i'll bring cold brew cans and a small cooler.  @nina @dylan if you want to add to drinks tab DM me.

nina: remote folks welcome to join audio call if they want to listen in. no pressure.

dylan: prize = tiny stuffed llama (gif attached) :joy:

zoe: cool. see you in kitchen! will post a quick reminder 30m before.
